import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction Amount Distribution by Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax1.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')

# 2. Transaction Count by Type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
transaction_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(transaction_counts))
ax2.bar(transaction_counts.index, transaction_counts.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Count by Type', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')

# 3. Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
scatter_colors = {'payment': '#FF6B6B', 'transfer': '#4ECDC4', 'refund': '#95E1D3'}
for trans_type in data['transaction_type'].unique():
    subset = data[data['transaction_type'] == trans_type]
    ax3.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
               label=trans_type, s=100, alpha=0.7, 
               color=scatter_colors.get(trans_type, '#888888'))
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax3.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
ax3.legend(title='Transaction Type')
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 4. Hourly Transaction Activity
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
hour_counts = data['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax4.plot(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='#FF6B6B')
ax4.fill_between(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#FF6B6B')
ax4.set_title('Transaction Activity by Hour', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
